canonical.title: Weekend in Arbre, anchored on L'Eau Vive

sources.title: L'Eau Vive — official site (EN)
sources.claim: Two-Michelin-star restaurant by Pierre Résimont in a 17th-century mill on the Burnot brook; closed Tue/Wed and Saturday lunch.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — L'Eau Vive, Arbre
sources.claim: Michelin entry lists the restaurant under Arbre (Namur).

sources.title: Le Cube — restaurant cottage (EN)
sources.claim: Pierre Résimont's 150 m² two-bedroom cottage in the restaurant garden.

sources.title: Le Cube — booking page (FR)
sources.claim: €300/night for two, €350 for four, breakfast €20 pp (no breakfast Tue/Wed).

sources.title: Be Perfect — Pierre Résimont 30 ans d'étoiles
sources.claim: Espace Médissey named for the Résimonts' two children Mehdi & Issey.

sources.title: Espace Médissey — official site
sources.claim: Bois-de-Villers villa with pool and hot tub, run by the Résimonts.

sources.title: Allo Taxi Namurois — Profondeville transfers
sources.claim: 24/7 local taxi operator covering the L'Eau Vive area.

sources.title: La Maison du Meunier — Crupet (FR)
sources.claim: Character lodging in Crupet (16 km), inside a Plus Beaux Villages de Wallonie.

sources.title: Beaux Villages — Grotte Saint-Antoine de Padoue
sources.claim: Crupet's devil-tableau grotto and 13th-century Carondelet keep.

sources.title: L'Échappée Belle — Booking listing
sources.claim: Lodging in Falaën, 15 km from L'Eau Vive, five minutes from the castle ruin.

sources.title: River Lodge — Maredret (EN)
sources.claim: Working watermill 14 km away with a Titanic-cabin themed suite.

sources.title: Visit Wallonia — Maredsous Abbey
sources.claim: Saint-Joseph cheese-and-beer centre at Maredsous Abbey, 5 minutes from River Lodge.

sources.title: Les Tanneurs — Namur (EN)
sources.claim: 15 connected 17th-century tannery houses in Namur old town, ~15 km from L'Eau Vive.

sources.title: Citadelle de Namur — prices and timetables
sources.claim: Citadelle de Namur opening hours and pricing.

sources.title: Taxi Profondeville — fare estimator
sources.claim: Estimated €25–30 each way for taxis between L'Eau Vive and nearby villages.

sources.title: KIKK Festival — official site
sources.claim: 21–25 October 2026, ~50 speakers on AI, dataviz, design and XR across Namur venues.

sources.title: Visit Wallonia — KIKK Festival
sources.claim: Saturday 24 October is a programmed conference day with 'KIKK In Town' art trail.

sources.title: Devoxx Belgium
sources.claim: Major Belgian developer conference in Antwerp, ~130 km outside the radius.

sources.title: Hepp'Taxi — Namur area
sources.claim: Second 24/7 local taxi operator in the L'Eau Vive area.

sources.title: L'Échappée Belle — official (EN)
sources.claim: B&B in Falaën, walking distance from the castle ruin.
